items.proposed: BRAF eligibility, candidate_matched true, matched_agent 'dabrafenib; trametinib'
items.reason: Entry requires 'Newly diagnosed high-grade glioma with BRAF^V600-mutation'; the manual's own example is 'BRAF V600E + BRAF/MEK inhibitor', and the record states the drugs act by 'blocking BRAF and MEK, respectively', so both candidates are matched.

items.proposed: BRAF eligibility, candidate_matched true, matched_agent 'dabrafenib; trametinib'
items.reason: Same biomarker row; the coders differ only in the matched agent. Trametinib (MEK inhibitor) is mechanistically linked to BRAF V600 per the manual example. candidate_matched_selection is true either way.

The single arm is 'Treatment (radiation therapy, dabrafenib, trametinib)'; both drugs are co-investigational candidates and radiotherapy precedes maintenance. Listing all experimental-arm antitumour therapy matches how both coders listed partners for other two-candidate trials (e.g. NCT07468136). regimen=combination is unaffected.

note: Paediatric/young-adult (3-25 y). Primary outcome candidate_matched_selection=true is not in dispute. The manual does not say whether a candidate's co-candidate belongs in combination_partners; XL may want a convention.
